parole.testo: Calque of German Doppelmoral or Spanish doble moral.

parole.significato: A narrow inlet of the sea formed by a flooded unglaciated river valley.
parole.testo: From German Ria, from Spanish ría (“inlet, estuary”), from Galician ría, from Galician río, from Latin.

parole.significato: Any of the three isomeric aromatic amines derived from toluene; they are used in the synthesis of certain dyes
parole.testo: Coined in 1845 by James Sheridan Muspratt and August Wilhelm von Hofmann who discovered the compound in the same year. They appended -ine to nitrotoluide, an obsolete term for nitrotoluene, which they reduced to get toluidine. Further, from German Nitrotoluid, from Toluid, an obsolete term for toluy
